test_command: conda dyg-cold; PYTHONPATH=edsgn/src;edsgn/scripts;edsgn/staging OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m pytest -q edsgn/tests/test_frozen_graph_state_diagnostic_v8.py

source_checks.evidence: collection_fingerprint hashes collection files; replay uses dataset loader on test_seed*.npz and emits oracle_npz_decoded=false; CPU test spies np.load and asserts no oracle path is opened.

replay forms expected_pairs from every PreparedData test origin, asserts exact order, B1 loop, writes validation-style predictions/targets/masks/origins/seed IDs, per-origin counters and compact trace.

main training checkpoint payload task schema is used; non-synthetic collections must match checkpoint train stats; synthetic path uses frozen_synthetic_stress.with_frozen_normalization; node order/horizons/count task are checked.
report explicitly states same-step graph can be matched but whole-window graph identity/refresh equality across retention arms is not claimed because future residual/adaptive feedback can differ.

test requires P2/P3 passed/pass, P3A passed/pass with evidence hashes, P4 running; resource helper/source/checkpoint/freeze/input collection hashes are rechecked after artifact serialization; cumulative budget guard runs before each origin, post prediction serialization, before/after report, and before receipt completion.
conservative estimate and disk free-space margin precede writes; exact self-inclusive artifact-byte count and cap are enforced.

limitation: The completed phase receipt is not populated with an explicit per-file outputs path/SHA list by this driver; it records output_dir and origin_count while the diagnostic report records artifact byte totals. Before any managed acceptance, the dispatcher/collector must hash and bind the final output files. The driver gate locally rechecks P2/P3 status/verdict but does not independently hash all P2/P3 predecessor evidence; it does hash P3A evidence. Root-managed dispatch must keep the full predecessor snapshot fence.
non_scientific: These 25 tests are CPU toy/guard fixtures, not a real frozen diagnostic run, model evaluation, H1/H2 result, or oracle analysis.
